sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @inactive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND EXISTS (SELECT cc.PimCategoryProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct cc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy ch ON ch.PimCategoryId = cc.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCatalog pbc ON pbc.PimCatalogId = ch.PimCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pcc ON pcc.PublishCatalogId = pbc.PublishCatalogId WHERE cc.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pcc.PortalId = po.PortalId) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId), @zero) >= @minStock AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
